title: Cognitive Multi-Agent Search and Rescue: Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collaborative Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2611.13161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective search and rescue (SAR) operations require autonomous systems capable of coordinating multiple heterogeneous agents, adapting to dynamic hazards, and aligning with human mission intent. Existing language-guided reinforcement learning (RL) methods primarily focus on single-agent instruction following and lack mechanisms for team-level coordination in complex, partially observable environments. This paper presents a Cognitive Multi-Agent Framework based on Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (LG-HRL) that integrates natural-language understanding, hierarchical policy decomposition, and a shared cognitive workspace to achieve cohesive multi-agent behavior in SAR scenarios. Human instructions are interpreted by a large language model (LLM) and transformed into structured semantic cues that guide high-level strategy selection and role assignment across UAV and UGV agents. translated_title: 认知多智能体搜索与救援：面向协作机器人的基于语言接地的分层强化学习
translated_abstract: 有效的搜索与救援（SAR）行动需要能够协调多个异构智能体、适应动态危险并与人类任务意图保持一致的自主系统。现有的语言引导强化学习（RL）方法主要集中于单智能体指令遵循，缺乏在复杂、部分可观测环境中进行团队级协调的机制。本文提出了一种基于语言接地的分层强化学习（LG-HRL）的认知多智能体框架，该框架集成了自然语言理解、分层策略分解和共享认知工作空间，以在搜索与救援场景中实现协调一致的多智能体行为。人类指令由大语言模型（LLM）解释并转化为结构化语义线索，用以指导无人机（UAV）和地面无人车（UGV）智能体的高层策略选择和角色分配。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于语言接地的分层强化学习（LG-HRL）认知多智能体框架，利用大语言模型将人类自然语言指令转化为结构化语义线索，结合共享认知工作空间，实现无人机与地面无人车在搜索救援任务中的团队级协调协作。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Cognitive Multi-Agent Framework based on Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (LG-HRL), which leverages an LLM to translate human instructions into structured semantic cues and a shared cognitive workspace to achieve team-level coordination among UAVs and UGVs in search and rescue missions.
